sections.label: Provider
sections.description: Configure one endpoint per provider. Switching reloads that provider's saved values.

buttons.label: 🔑 Sign in via browser
buttons.description: Open the provider's console to create or copy an API key.

sections.label: Base URL
sections.description: OpenAI-compatible API base URL for the selected provider.

sections.label: API Key
sections.placeholder: Paste API key — it is saved and tested automatically
sections.description: Bearer token for the endpoint. Pasting a key auto-saves it and tests the connection. Not needed for most local servers.

sections.label: Text model
sections.description: Used for chat, code editing, explanations, and other text tasks. Type a model id or pick from fetched models.

sections.label: Image model
sections.description: Used only for plugin icon and other image-generation tasks.

buttons.label: ⬇ Fetch models
buttons.description: Query the endpoint's /models list and split it into text and image models.

sections.label: Temperature
sections.description: Sampling temperature (0 = deterministic, higher = more random).

sections.label: Max tokens
sections.description: Maximum number of tokens to generate per response.

buttons.label: 🔌 Test connection
buttons.description: Check the endpoint responds to a /models request.

buttons.label: 💾 Save
buttons.description: Persist the current provider's settings to ~/.chisurf/ai_api_settings.json.

buttons.label: ↺ Reset
buttons.description: Reset the current provider's fields to defaults (not saved until you press Save).
